headline: Mideast de-escalation hopes pull crude lower as diesel cracks stay sky-high
intro: Crude is backing off its Houthi-attack highs on talk of Saudi-Turkish diplomacy with Tehran, but don't be fooled — diesel cracks north of $113/bbl and retail diesel above $6.27 say the distillate market hasn't gotten the memo.
overview: Oil prices eased Monday as Saudi, Pakistani, and Turkish officials headed to Tehran to defuse tensions after last week's spike above $117 Brent on Houthi strikes near Rabigh refinery and the East-West pipeline. Refined products are mixed, with gasoline cracks holding near $13.78/bbl while diesel cracks remain extraordinarily elevated at $113.24/bbl amid tight EU diesel/jet supply and reports of refinery hits in Saudi Arabia. On the policy side, D6 RINs are falling faster than D4 as the conventional biofuel balance loosens, while refiner equities like Par Pacific rallied on diesel-tightness optimism.

stories.title: Oil prices climb as Saudi attacks heighten supply concerns
stories.summary: Oil prices rose more than 3% on Oct. 23, with Brent climbing above $117/bbl — its highest since late April — and WTI above $103/bbl, on escalating Saudi attack fears.

stories.title: WTI, Brent Crude Fall on Mideast Diplomatic Talks
stories.summary: WTI and Brent crude fell Monday morning as Saudi, Pakistani and Turkish officials prepared to meet in Tehran to try to prevent further Middle East escalation.

stories.title: Saudi, Turkish Officials Travel to Iran to Cool Tensions
stories.summary: Top security officials from Saudi Arabia, Pakistan and Turkey are set to meet Iran's leaders to defuse tensions and revive talks aimed at preventing a broader war.

stories.title: Houthis Claim Strikes on Rabigh Refinery and East-West Pipeline
stories.summary: Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree claimed strikes on the Rabigh refinery and East-West Pipeline pumping stations; Saudi Arabia has not confirmed damage.

stories.title: Brent Tops $116 as Middle East Risks Grow
stories.summary: Oil prices climbed as escalating attacks on Saudi Arabia heightened fears of Middle East supply disruptions, with Brent topping $116.

stories.title: EU Diesel, Jet Fuel Supplies Remain Tight
stories.summary: EU diesel and jet fuel supplies remain tight, though the European Commission says there is currently no physical shortage of these products.

stories.title: Germany Wants to Stop More Oil Refinery Closures
stories.summary: Germany said it will seek to stem the loss of oil refining capacity amid closures.

stories.title: Mixed Start To October's Final Trading Week As Crude Retreats
stories.summary: A mixed start to the last trading week of October, with refined products chopping around break-even overnight while crude contracts lose $1.5-$2/barrel.

stories.title: Par Pacific Shares Rise 7% as Refiner Rebounds From Recent Slide With Diesel Tightness and Earnings in Focus
stories.summary: Par Pacific shares rose 7% as investors returned to refining stocks on elevated margins and tight global fuel supplies, despite no company-specific catalyst.

stories.title: D6 RINs fall further than D4 as the conventional balance looks more comfortable
stories.summary: US RIN values have fallen sharply since mid-October generation data, with D6 credits declining more heavily than D4 as the conventional biofuel balance looks more comfortable.

stories.title: Moeve, Galp end negotiations on potential downstream combination
stories.summary: Moeve and Galp ended negotiations on a potential downstream combination, failing to reach terms meeting their strategic and financial criteria.

stories.title: Agra Energy achieves TRL 9 with demonstration of FT liquid fuels at Wisconsin facility
stories.summary: Agra Energy achieved TRL 9 with a demonstration of Fischer-Tropsch liquid fuels, producing SAF and renewable naphtha from dairy-farm gas at a new Wisconsin facility.

stories.title: Gasoline Prices Under Trump Surpass Biden-Era Average
stories.summary: Average US gasoline prices under Trump have now surpassed the Biden-era average, raising political stakes for Republicans ahead of the midterms.

stories.title: Approved Oil Secures Long-Term New York City Fuel Terminal Agreement with Sunoco, Ensuring Supply Capacity into The 2040s
stories.summary: Approved Oil secured a long-term fuel terminal agreement with Sunoco in New York City, extending supply capacity into the 2040s.
